decisions.title: AUDIO PATH LIVE — verified end-to-end in production
decisions.note: User added ASR key. Voice sample → transcribe (1.3s, correct punctuation) → full 5-quote package generated from the audio. Verified via scripts/verify-unlocks.mjs. GLM: dual-endpoint integration now targets the Z.ai coding-plan URL with correct model names (glm-4.6/4.5-air) — authenticates, but the key's account needs an active resource package (error 1113). Deterministic engine unaffected.

decisions.title: Demo video + OG rebuilt in the flat design
decisions.note: All 8 demo frames recaptured from the live flat-design app; title/end cards flattened; vertical cut rebuilt; OG regenerated. Video, GIF, and social cards now match what users see.

decisions.title: Redesign carried through inner pages (+ import fix)
decisions.note: Found + fixed a redesign regression: an over-broad regex had stripped theme.css's @import from tool.css, leaving tools/app/guides/comparisons unstyled. All 7 inner page classes verified on the new design system via computed-style sweep.

decisions.title: Visual redesign: midnight editorial
decisions.note: User: 'the UI is so ugly'. Full redesign: Fraunces serif + Inter, deep-ink palette with gold gradient CTAs, glow wash, glass cards, responsive/native across form factors (breakpoints 1024/720/480, 48px touch targets, safe-areas). Fonts moved to preconnect links after @import dropped Lighthouse perf to 77; contrast fixes restored a11y to 100. Final: P94/A100/BP96/SEO100. Proof images recaptured.

decisions.title: Mobile polish + demo loader
decisions.note: Mobile audit (390px) found a wrapping nav; secondary links now collapse on small screens. Added a one-click demo-transcript loader to the paste flow (biggest first-run friction: having nothing to paste). Verified live on mobile viewport.

decisions.title: False-incident guard in the ops loop
decisions.note: Short uptime probes tripped the input guards (400 = guard working, not an outage). The ROADMAP now pins the exact 5-sentence canonical probe body so scheduled sessions can't misdiagnose a healthy API. Automation confirmed alive (runCount 1, next run scheduled).

decisions.title: Burst test caught the ASR-case bug
decisions.note: The 60-request concurrency test exposed that sentence splitting required capitalized sentence starts — all-lowercase ASR transcripts (common) collapsed to one sentence and hard-failed the guard. Fixed (case-insensitive splitting + proportional segments); re-tested under burst: 60/60 OK at p50 0.46s / p90 1.89s. 69/69 tests.

decisions.title: Field scan clear; A7 post pre-drafted
decisions.note: No mentions of EpisodeKit on HN/Reddit yet — Tuesday's story is unpreempted. The A7 transparency post is fully drafted with launch-week numbers as the only blanks (docs/sprint-report-draft.md).

decisions.title: Unlock verification: one command
decisions.note: scripts/verify-unlocks.mjs proves the audio pipeline end-to-end with a synthesized voice sample (say → ffmpeg → transcribe → full suite) the moment ASR keys land, and guides the LS test-order check for payments. Wired into FOR-ABID + ROADMAP; verified against the disabled state.

decisions.title: Webhook signature robustness
decisions.note: The LS webhook now verifies signatures against all plausible body serializations (raw, JSON.stringify, sorted-keys) and logs signature mismatches with payload previews — a Vercel parsing quirk can no longer silently reject real orders on activation day.

decisions.title: Pre-activation crash fixed
decisions.note: Tracing the GLM-activation path caught a latent crash: the discussion tool's AI response lacked the `apply` field its renderer indexes. The prompt now requests it, and the page overlays AI output on the heuristic shape with per-field guards — activation can no longer break the tool.

decisions.title: Input-hardening complete
decisions.note: Adversarial pass closed the last empty-output shapes: no-punctuation, all-short-sentences, and repetition inputs now return honest 400s with friendly client messages; duplicate sentences are deduped. The engine now behaves correctly across clean, labeled, accented, hostile, and degenerate inputs — 66/66 tests.

decisions.title: Real-transcript quality: speaker labels handled
decisions.note: Real ASR output (Host:/Speaker 1:) was polluting themes and titles. Labels are now stripped in normalization + stopworded; quotes stay verbatim vs spoken content. Also fixed a timestamp-dependent flaky license test (65/65 across 3 runs).

decisions.title: Launch-readiness: latency verified, reaction time halved
decisions.note: 30-request production smoke: p50 0.38s / p90 0.59s / 0 failures on the free-tool API. Automation now runs 9am + 9pm with unlock-detection first — any LS/key activation is verified within 12 hours and the map updates.

decisions.title: A1 executed 2 days early; product frozen for launch
decisions.note: Full A1 checklist green on production (5 uptime endpoints, 4 generation modes, 503/audio + false/payments states correct, CJK guard, 62 tests). FOR-ABID.md condenses the user's five actions to one page; A7 report template ready — the sprint now only waits on the user-side unlocks.

decisions.title: Launch hardening: language guard + v1.0.0
decisions.note: Non-Latin transcripts now fail honestly (400 + friendly notice) instead of rendering empty artifacts; metrics puller aggregates sk_* events from Vercel logs for launch-day tracking; founding email drafted; GitHub release v1.0.0 published.

decisions.title: Sprint compressed: 30 days → 7 days (user request)
decisions.note: The build finished early (21 sessions delivered the original week-3 scope in 3 days), so the sprint is now a 7-day launch execution ending 2026-11-02: unlock day → Show HN → distribution → Product Hunt → hardening → compound → all-numbers report.

decisions.title: Site-wide QA sweep
decisions.note: Crawled all 15 pages locally + 14 live routes (zero broken links; two regex false-positives were JS template literals). Lighthouse re-run caught an a11y regression from content added since day 5 (color-only links) — fixed with underlines; landing back to 100/100/100.

decisions.title: Second content pillar live
decisions.note: The repurposing playbook targets the category term every directory/competitor uses, with an effort/return priority table, the batch workflow, and the verbatim rule — completing the internal-link graph around the tools.

decisions.title: Deterministic quality pass
decisions.note: Until GLM keys land, the deterministic engine IS the product — so its copy got a rewrite: six varied discussion follow-ups (was 3 rotating), sharper apply prompts, and a 'What X Gets Wrong About Y' pair-template for titles. Sample regenerated; 62/62 tests.

decisions.title: Launch ops hardening
decisions.note: Gallery images pre-cropped to PH's exact 1270×760 spec; the daily build loop now starts with a 4-endpoint uptime check that self-heals (redeploy) and logs incidents; README shows verified sample output (a quote I initially mis-attributed was corrected against the actual generated JSON).

decisions.title: Bug fix: every 'email us' CTA was dead
decisions.note: The site pointed at @episodekit.app addresses — a domain we don't own, so those emails silently bounced. Replaced with a contact page backed by /api/contact (durable sk_contact log); all mailto: and stale-address references removed.

decisions.title: Content pillar + conversion bridge
decisions.note: A genuinely useful complete guide to podcast show notes (head-term SEO, links template/tools/comparisons), and every free tool now offers 'generate the full package with this transcript' — carrying the text into the app via sessionStorage (never leaves the browser).

decisions.title: First-run honesty + Shorts asset
decisions.note: The app now asks /api/config whether audio transcription is live and defaults to the paste tab with a clear explanation until it is — no more dead-end first click. A 1080x1920 vertical cut of the demo is ready for Shorts/TikTok at launch.

decisions.title: Launch-day de-risking: validator hardening + LS runbook
decisions.note: The verbatim-quote validator now tolerates real LLM output habits (curly quotes, em-dashes, ellipsis-marked fragments) instead of silently falling back to deterministic — paraphrases still rejected (62 tests). Plus a 15-minute click-path runbook so Lemon Squeezy activation works first try.

decisions.title: Self-serve indexing + repo credibility
decisions.note: IndexNow key deployed and all 10 URLs submitted (HTTP 202) — Bing/Yandex indexing without an account. GitHub Actions CI runs the 60 tests on every push (badge live), README now leads with an 8s demo GIF, and every tool/template/compare page carries og:image.

decisions.title: Open-sourced the build: github.com/gitAbid/episodekit
decisions.note: Distribution without new accounts: the full repo (engine, site, day logs, tests) is public with topics. Infra account ids redacted from logs first; secrets scan clean (.vercel/ ignored). Also checked for GLM/ASR keys in the environment — none exposed, so AI/audio activation remains user-side.

decisions.title: Template + structured data shipped
decisions.note: Copyable show-notes template page with a worked example (targets template-intent searches, funnels to the generator), plus FAQ section and SoftwareApplication+FAQPage JSON-LD on the landing for rich results.

decisions.title: Launch pack complete; metrics baseline recorded
decisions.note: Paste-ready PH submission (gallery, maker first-comment) and Show HN post (free-tool link meeting the try-it-now rule, technical first comment on the verbatim validator). METRICS.md baseline: all current traffic is agent verification; distribution still gated on user accounts.

decisions.title: Demo video #1 shipped (frame-sequenced, narrated)
decisions.note: The browser recorder proved unusable (guest kills recordings), so the demo is built deterministically: 8 full-bleed frames from the live app + Ken Burns zoom + crossfades + TTS narration + branded title/end cards, composed with ffmpeg. 38s, 7.7MB, streams with range support; embedded on the landing page.

decisions.title: Product decision: content-suite engine
decisions.note: 3 parallel research agents. Mass clip market saturated ($14–29/mo floor); verticals pay 2–4×. Model: freemium + usage credits via Lemon Squeezy (MoR). Distribution: free-tool SEO + 1:1 replies + launch windows.

decisions.title: Engine ships with verbatim-quote honesty validator
decisions.note: Deterministic-first engine (works with zero API keys) + GLM path where any AI quote that isn't an exact substring of the source is rejected. Sample package committed unedited as proof.

decisions.title: Live on production, perfect Lighthouse
decisions.note: Vercel deploy; deployment protection disabled; domain auto-attach fixed (manual aliases go stale). Performance 100 / Accessibility 100 / Best Practices 96 / SEO 100.

decisions.title: Positioning pivot: podcasters (religion-neutral)
decisions.note: User set a hard constraint: no religious-domain products. Full rebrand to EpisodeKit — same engine, new artifacts (article/show notes, discussion kit, email series), new CC0 demo, religion-free test gates. Podcast vertical was research rank-2 (Podsqueeze $9–89/mo, Castmagic $19–699/mo).

decisions.title: Payment rail built ahead of schedule
decisions.note: Stateless HMAC license keys (SK1/SK4/SKF), signature-verified LS webhook, checkout config endpoint, in-app activation. Inert until Lemon Squeezy credentials arrive — then payments are live in minutes.

decisions.title: SEO assets: show-notes generator + comparison pages
decisions.note: Free no-signup 'podcast show notes generator' (the market's money keyword) + honest vs-Podsqueeze / vs-Castmagic pages with attributed facts. Server-side sk_usage events make activation measurable from Vercel logs alone.

decisions.title: This live sprint map
decisions.note: status.json is updated by every daily build session; the map also polls live counters (pageviews, waitlist) every 30 seconds.
